name: openbot
description: Self-hosted agent team you chat with. Electron app + local server.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @openbot/desktop run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @openbot/desktop run dev
scripts.dev:packages: tsc --build --watch packages/shared packages/core packages/client packages/server packages/skills-mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/shared packages/core packages/client packages/server packages/skills-mcp && pnpm --filter @openbot/desktop run typecheck
